title: Clear Picks: Header Band And Report Clip
brands: Follow-on to Clear Picks: App Header & Video (10/10): the color band header won every head-to-head, so this refines the band, the report clip, the end card and the big house picture.
Smart Upkeep brand: white and cream, terracotta, lagoon and jungle accents, Khand and Hind, light mode only. Trust badges: approved set only.
request: Max Oct 17 2026 14:59 ICT: if i swiped on anything today, make sure a new deck is built with the same type of content
example_data: All numbers, names and reviews on cards are labeled example data or placeholders.
